title: The Lantern-Bearing Fox
statement: They say when the first winter grew too dark for travelers to find their way home, a small fox stole a single ember from the moon's own hearth and ran the night roads carrying it in her mouth. The gods, moved by her mischief and her kindness, set her mid-stride among the stars — tail high, ember blazing at her nose — so that anyone lost beneath a black sky can look up and find her light still running ahead of them.
